name: European Union (AMLR-based)
notice: For training only. Based on Regulation (EU) 2024/1624, which applies from 10 July 2027. Member State rules apply until then, and the common report format was still in draft when this profile was written. Not legal advice.

info.what: An internal report to the officer who decides whether an STR is sent to the FIU.
info.when: Select it when your review leaves you with knowledge or suspicion.
info.mistake: Delaying the internal report until the suspicion has been proved.

info.what: A report to the Financial Intelligence Unit of the Member State concerned.
info.when: Select it when the case should be disclosed to the FIU.
info.mistake: Writing a report that gives the facts but not the reason for suspicion.

routes.label: AMLA

info.what: The EU Anti-Money Laundering Authority, which coordinates supervision and supports FIUs.
info.when: Check which body receives reports from obliged entities before selecting it.
info.mistake: Confusing the roles of EU and national authorities.

routes.debrief: AMLA supports and coordinates national FIUs but does not replace them. Suspicions are reported to the FIU.

info.what: The national authority that supervises the firm's compliance.
info.when: Select it for matters about the firm's regulatory obligations.
info.mistake: Assuming that a supervisor and the FIU have the same role.

info.what: Direct contact with the police, under the firm's procedures.
info.when: Select it when a crime in progress or an immediate risk to someone needs urgent action.
info.mistake: Assuming that an STR is the way to report an immediate risk.

routes.label: Inform the customer

info.what: Telling the customer about the review or what has been decided about it.
info.when: Consider it only where the law and your firm's procedures allow it.
info.mistake: Not thinking about what the conversation could reveal.

routes.debrief: Article 73 of Regulation (EU) 2024/1624 prohibits disclosing to the customer that information is being or has been reported.

sections.label: Escalation note
sections.help: State briefly what you saw and why it needs further review.

sections.label: Summary of activity
sections.help: Choose the text that states the facts: who, what, where and when.

sections.label: Reason for suspicion
sections.help: Choose the text that explains why the facts are suspicious.

sections.label: Action taken
sections.help: Choose the text that records what was done.
